_schema_note: Errata closure protocol, item E2: one-time bibliography audit. Every entry in verified-citations.json was re-fetched from its authoritative source (Crossref by DOI where a DOI exists; DataCite for the one DOI Crossref does not carry; the arXiv abstract page or publisher/venue page otherwise) and diffed field-by-field (authors, year, venue, volume, pages) against the stored record. Discrepancies were corrected through the normal verification pipeline directly in verified-citations.json (never hand-typed past the fetch), with each fix's rationale recorded in that entry's own verified_via field; refs.bib was then regenerated from the corrected verified-citations.json via paper-tex/generate_refs_bib.py, never hand-edited. No scientific content (results, claims, tags, proofs, seeds) was touched. Every DOI-bearing entry's 'venue' (its journal or booktitle field, whichever applies) and 'volume' are recorded here even when they matched, specifically so run_gates.py's G9 gate can check current verified-citations.json values against this audited-authoritative snapshot on every run without re-fetching the network itself (gates in this repo are deterministic and offline-capable by convention) -- a hand-edit that silently drifts a DOI-bearing entry's volume or venue away from its audited value becomes a G9 failure.
